items.why: Hitting a fresh record after Citi hiked its target to a Street high $800, saying AI agents will drive huge CPU demand. CEO Lisa Su also said AMD will substantially boost chip supply in 2027.
Fear gauge sinking as stocks rally broadly; the S&P 500 touched a record high today while Treasury yields eased.
No single headline; moving with the broader tape. Tech is bid as AI power deals make news, including Google's big nuclear power agreement with Constellation Energy.
Melius Research upgraded the stock to Buy from Hold, calling Microsoft the 'adults in charge' of AI, with a $665 target; Scotiabank also raised its target to $615 from $510.

market_note: Futures were pointing higher all morning and the broad tape is following through.
summary: Stocks are powering to fresh records, with the S&P 500 hitting an all time high as bond yields retreat and oil prices slip. Chips are leading the charge on renewed AI optimism.
